rows.details: Acharya N. G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU)

content_sections.heading: ANGRAU SRF Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the project titled "Mainstreaming rice landraces diversity in varietal development through genome-wide association studies: A model for large scale utilization of gene bank collections of rice" at Regional Agricultural Research Station, Maruteru.

rows.qualification_required: M.Sc. (Ag) Entomology / Plant Pathology / Plant Breeding / Agril. Biotechnology (ASRB NET certificate)

content_sections.heading: ANGRAU SRF Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit varies by gender as follows:

content_sections.heading: ANGRAU SRF Salary
content_sections.text: The position is temporary for a period of 11 months or until the completion of the project, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: ANGRAU SRF Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: ANGRAU SRF Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected based on a walk-in interview. Eligible candidates can directly attend the interview on the specified date with all original certificates, a duplicate copy, and other relevant documents.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Application on plain paper giving bio-data Name and address of two references Latest passport size photograph All original certificates with a duplicate copy Attested photocopies of supporting documents No objection certificate (if employed)

content_sections.heading: ANGRAU SRF Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview. The above post is purely on temporary basis. Eligible candidates can directly attend for interview on the said date with all original certificates and a duplicate copy. Employed candidates must submit a no objection certificate at the time of interview. The decision of the selection committee is final and binding in all aspects.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this notification?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Acharya N. G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU), Regional Agricultural Research Station, Maruteru.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this ANGRAU notification?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 13.10.2026 at 2.00 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for the ANGRAU SRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.Sc. (Ag) in Entomology, Plant Pathology, Plant Breeding, or Agril. Biotechnology along with an ASRB NET certificate.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for men and women candidates?
faq.answer: Men must be below 35 years of age, and women must be below 40 years of age.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive Rs. 42,000/- plus HRA as per eligibility.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at RARS, Maruteru.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the post is purely on a temporary basis for a period of 11 months or until the completion of the project, whichever is earlier.
